name: agent-board
description: A live board for Claude Code inside VS Code: every conversation's subagents and their task details, subscription usage, and context fill, fed by the agent-board mod

agentBoard.autoReveal.description: Show the board by itself while 2 or more subagents run at once (it does not take the input focus).

agentBoard.usageInStatusBar.description: Keep the subscription usage (the 5-hour session and the weekly limit) on the right of the status bar; it changes color near the limit.

agentBoard.usageOfDesktopApp.description: Also show the usage of an account only the Claude desktop app uses. Off by default: with the desktop app signed in to another account, the board shows only the account VS Code uses.

agentBoard.contextInStatusBar.description: Show the current conversation's context fill on the right of the status bar; it follows the Claude tab you open and changes color near the limit.

agentBoard.notify.waiting.description: Notify when a Claude conversation has waited over 15 seconds for your answer or your permission.

agentBoard.notify.subagents.description: Notify when a subagent finishes or fails (3 or more at once fold into one notification).

agentBoard.notify.turnDone.description: Notify when a conversation finishes a turn it worked on for over 2 minutes.

agentBoard.notify.usage.description: Notify when the 5-hour or weekly limit crosses 80% or 90%.

agentBoard.dataDirectory.description: The folder the agent-board mod writes its snapshots to; empty means ~/.claude/agent-board/sessions.
